name: repeated-key
what: Injection (b), the repeated key. One response makes an unremarkable call and two calls whose arguments name a key twice, so that one value could be shown and another acted on. The provider layer reads arguments strictly: the response is malformed and is discarded whole. Nothing of it is decided or run, the unremarkable call included.
request: Read the test value, then set it.

turns.text: I will read the value and then set it.
